# Pay app guides: schedule of values calculator and pay application guides

> Free, private schedule of values / continuation sheet calculator for construction subcontractors (work completed, stored materials, retainage held and released, balance to finish, current payment due), plus plain-English guides on filling out a pay application, retainage with cited public retainage caps for 12 US states, conditional vs unconditional lien waivers, and change orders. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Not legal, tax, accounting or financial advice. Not affiliated with the American Institute of Architects and does not reproduce the AIA G702/G703 forms. Statutes were read on 2026-11-24; check the linked statute before relying on it. Hosted pay-app billing for subcontractors is in development, with early access; nothing is for sale yet.

## Pages

- [Schedule of values calculator](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/): continuation-sheet arithmetic, over-billing check, summary, CSV.
- [How to fill out a pay application](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/how-to-fill-out-a-pay-application.html): every column and summary line with a worked example.
- [Retainage explained](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/retainage-explained.html): calculation, reduction, release, flow-down, and public retainage caps for CA, TX, FL, NY, PA, IL, NC, MI, VA, WA, MA, AZ with official statute links.
- [Conditional vs unconditional lien waivers](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/conditional-vs-unconditional-lien-waivers.html): the four waiver types, when to sign each, California and Florida statutory forms.
- [Free schedule of values template (Excel)](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/schedule-of-values-template.html): a blank .xlsx continuation sheet and summary with the formulas in (total completed and stored, percent, balance to finish, per-line retainage, payment due, an over-billing check), plus a filled-in example. No macros or external links; opens in Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice.
- [Statutory lien waiver forms by state](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/lien-waiver-forms-by-state.html): which states set the waiver wording by statute (Arizona, Nevada, Texas, Utah, Florida, Michigan, Wyoming read on the official sites on 2026-11-25; California linked), how many forms, how strictly each must be followed, and the traps in each.
- [Change orders and the schedule of values](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/change-orders-schedule-of-values.html): approved and deductive change orders on the SOV and summary.
- [Retainage in QuickBooks Online](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/retainage-in-quickbooks.html): QuickBooks has no retainage field; the Retainage Receivable account and item, the negative invoice line, the release invoice, finding unbilled retainage outside A/R aging, the cash-basis caveat, and an invoice-line calculator. Sources are Intuit help and community pages.
- [Prompt payment laws for subcontractors](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/prompt-payment-laws.html): how many days a GC has to pass the owner's payment down to a sub, and late-payment interest, in Texas, California, Illinois, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Virginia (public work) and Florida, each linked to the statute (read 2026-11-25; rates given only where the text read confirmed them), plus a late-payment interest calculator.
